context:
# Goal
Kama round 11 inherited-work verification. L1 owns planner seat. C1 CALIBRATION (lowest assigned, score 7; operability 8): 9 legacy files missing 27 provenance fields ->0, original byte prefixes preserved, no runtime freshness claim. C2 COVERAGE: one new served-identity crosswalk adds remote tags/expiry/nullable loading/router/alias limits beyond preexisting tags/ps distinction. Scores unchanged unless objective denominator exists. Axis source is ../shokunin.conf current row, NOT historical MISSION example. Parent integrates all code/docs and runs acceptance AFTER this wave; seats no tests/build/lint/formatters. Every result advisory: outside non-author review remains separate.
# Contract
Leaf only, no delegation, no commits, pushes, host configs, environments, service or network endpoint probes. Public documentation opening allowed. Sole write set is your unique .ufo/waves/round-11/verification/<name>.md advisory report; NEVER modify implementation/corpus/fleet repo. Read assigned files with tools and report grounded defects with exact paths and lines, severity and smallest repair, plus what is already correct. Do not invent results; do not run checks. Source roles MUST open assigned public URL and capture <=25-word located quote/date. Explicitly report no installs or actual install record.
You and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in the report).
